SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'Restaurant'
    OR (r."food_service" = 'Café' AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian');
111:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
113:
SELECT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";
114:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id";
261:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX(CAST("salary" AS REAL)) FROM "jobs");
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer')
    AND "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL;
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
265:
SELECT j."preferred_years"
FROM "jobs" j
WHERE j."salary" = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(j2."salary" AS REAL))
    FROM "jobs" j2
)
LIMIT 1;
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."salary"
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
